items.text: FIXTURE: 10-year Treasury yield 4.3%, up 0.2 points in a month.
FIXTURE: 10-year minus 2-year spread +0.4 points, curve no longer inverted.
FIXTURE: policy rate 3.6%, unchanged at the last meeting.
FIXTURE: CPI inflation 2.8% year on year, latest release for December.
FIXTURE: VIX at 17, below its one-year average.
FIXTURE: WTI crude $68 a barrel, down 6% in a month.
